generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of looking back on your own work that will serve you in every module from here on. Each task you meet is a chance to reflect, each honest look-back a pointer to what to do next, and the two together are how your work improves across the degree. The habit to keep is simple: look back on what you did, be honest and balanced about it, and let it shape the next piece of work.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you work, are asked how a piece of work went, and decide what to change, the people who get better are the ones who treat each round as feeding the next. The reflection you have just learned to do is one you will use long after you graduate.
